desc:
Welcome to SONIC.exe: FALLEN MEMORIES, the DEFINITIVE Outcome Memories remake.

! FORMERLY TITLED YAOMR (YET ANOTHER OM REVIVAL) !

This is the REWORK version of the game. Many things will differ from the older version

Fallen Memories is an ASYM survival game inspired by TD and Outcome Memories, whereas you play as either a survivor or an executioner, where one side has to win by escaping or eliminating the threat, and the other has to execute anyone in sight. Do you have what it takes?

THIS IS NOT INTENDED TO BE A 1:1 TO OUTCOME MEMORIES. EXPECT MANY, MANY DIFFERENCES.

Heavily inspired by Outcome Memories (wow who couldve guessed)
Play the original game here: https://www.roblox.com/games/14608970270/

Join the comms server for updates, announcements, and more!

All credits go to SEGA/Sonic Team for the characters used ingame
SONG CREDITS: Ohaikou Music, astranova, Vasalto, Monotono, ace_hedge, Jack Lundy, etc.
